title: Capacity sweep: logistic/GBT/MLP/SVM on cached feature views
why: Find the highest achievable accuracy with compute-free capacity+ensembling and state the gap to 95%.
hypothesis: Higher-capacity models on the full cached feature set beat the linear two-view baseline in-domain and transfer to OOD grouped CV.
data: IndEgo gold 150 (LOCO); OOD-160 (grouped); confirmatory 108 (evaluate only); cached features
method: Nested grouped CV (LOCO gold, leave-one-factory-out OOD): standardise+impute, inner-CV hyperparameter selection, AUROC + BA + grouped bootstrap CI.

title: Ensembling/stacking: two views x adapted x rules x new features
why: Find the highest achievable accuracy with compute-free capacity+ensembling and state the gap to 95%.
hypothesis: Nested stacking of pixel/EG2/adapted/rules base scores clears 0.95 in-domain and improves OOD over the best single scorer.
data: IndEgo gold 150 (LOCO); OOD-160 (grouped); confirmatory 108 (evaluate only); cached features
method: Rank-average and nested logistic meta-learner over OOF base scores; paired grouped bootstrap gains.

title: Regime-specific heads, hold-out 108, compute cost, verdict
why: Find the highest achievable accuracy with compute-free capacity+ensembling and state the gap to 95%.
hypothesis: Per-regime heads + routing beat a single global model across domains; the confirmatory 108 quantifies the honest gap to 95%.
data: IndEgo gold 150 (LOCO); OOD-160 (grouped); confirmatory 108 (evaluate only); cached features
method: E4-descriptor regimes + routing; frozen recipes applied once to the 108 hold-out; measured compute cost; verdict.
